meta.description: Meta SuperDex native bot assets ingested into RoboParts. Each entity is a `superdex_bot_v1` — a JSON-native articulated robot definition with kinematics + inertial parameters, ready for SuperDex Physics simulation.

entities.name: SuperDex Franka FR3 v2

mechanical_interface.declared_note: Franka FR3 v2 (post-2024) tool flange is unchanged from FR3 v1: ISO 9409-1-50-4-M6. See Franka API docs `tool_flange_joint_name`.
